dataset.name: MSK resected PDAC RNA-seq cohort (GSE124231)
dataset.description: Independent treatment-naive resected pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cohort with primary-tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual disease-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study prospectively collected 54 surgically resected PDAC tumors at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. Direct bulk RNA sequencing passed source release for 48 tumors; all 48 expression-linked patients have individual disease-free-survival time and recurrence status in the publication supplement.

metadata.source_program: Memorial Sloan Kettering prospective resected PDAC study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Nature Communications Supplementary Data 2
metadata.library_method: Ribosomal-RNA-depleted bulk RNA sequencing of EpCAM-enriched primary PDAC cells, aligned to hg19 with STAR 2.5.0b and counted at exon level with HTSeq 0.9.1
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-defined disease-free survival after surgical resection, updated through July 2020
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The supplement labels the endpoint DFS and supplies recurrence status and follow-up in days. TRACE Explorer preserves that source definition and does not reinterpret it as TCGA DFI or PFI.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The GEO subseries exposes one RNA count profile for each of 48 patients. Six additional clinical records without a released RNA profile are excluded by a deterministic patient-key join.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: Nature Communications Supplementary Data 2 contains 54 individual records. A declared normalization maps source keys such as Pt 10 and GEO titles such as RNA-Seq PT10_1 to the same PT10 linkage key; exactly 48 records match the count-matrix columns.
metadata.expression_curation_note: TRACE Explorer computes library sizes over all 57,905 source Ensembl rows, applies log2(CPM + 1), maps hg19 Ensembl identifiers with the pinned GRCh37 release 75 annotation and excludes 248 symbols represented by multiple Ensembl genes, leaving 55,630 analyzable symbols.
metadata.overlap_note: The MSK cohort is independent of TCGA-PAAD and of the active UAB, OHSU, MCW, LAPNET, CPTAC, POG570 and ICGC pancreatic cohorts.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO matrix and CC BY 4.0 supplementary workbook in place. Direct source-file redistribution remains disabled under the conservative repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Treatment-naive surgically resected primary PDAC tumor

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 75 GRCh37 gene_name annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols assigned to more than one Ensembl gene are excluded rather than silently combined.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM across all 57,905 source rows for each selected tumor, applies log2(CPM + 1), maps source Ensembl identifiers to pinned GRCh37 release 75 gene symbols and excludes ambiguous symbols. Values are intended for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-defined disease-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: First documented disease recurrence according to the source supplement
